rng_rule: Fold each declared seed into its original saved native/aux RNG, paired across arms; no reinitialization of model/optimizer state and no extra native RNG consumption by penalties.
primary_return: float64 sum(t=0..99) gamma**t * reward_t; each final actor supplies every action; no candidate reranking
selection: Final declared update only. Evaluate once after all six training runs complete and exports are sealed. No outcome-based intermediate selection, early stopping, strength tuning or automatic extension.
primary_screen: BCA mean paired return gain versus native AND distance must exceed the mean symmetric numerical band in EACH stream. Band per episode=1e-6+1e-6*max(abs(BCA_return),abs(control_return)). Exploratory numerical direction screen, not statistical superiority.
state_action_shift: Action displacement on the same 128 logged validation observations; separately state-trajectory displacement relative to the original actor on shared reset seeds. Descriptive change, not OOD coverage.
initialization_scope: Two replay/noise continuation streams from one trained checkpoint, not independent training initialization replications.
preserved: Exact standalone UniFloral TD3BC twin critics, actor/target networks, optimizer moments, BC term, normalization, gamma/horizon/masks, smoothing law, and original BCA local architecture/objective/Bayesian-conformal mechanism. Independent output states only.
